title: ledger events from a call with an explicit project root land in the cwd's project, not that root
detail: ledger.append always resolves ledger_path() via project_root() (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or a cwd walk). Callers that operate on an explicit root, e.g. discovery.dep_graph(root) / fingerprint_map, and issues, log their event into whatever project the cwd resolves to, not into root/.sprint/ledger.jsonl. Surfaced by the brief-critic of hermetic-test-ledger (fb-f3f196654458): several test leaks into the engine's real ledger were this path (dep_graph(tmp_path) run from the repo cwd). Fix: thread the root through append (append(event, root=...)) for root-scoped operations.
